messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, with movement stopping at board edges and preserving the remembered tab stop. Added a regression check for movement during a mismatch and onto matched cards.

The build, type checks, and all 138 unit tests passed. The browser suite passed 75 of 76 checks; an artwork geometry check timed out, then passed when rerun on its own.
